{{Quote| Altaca's slave group was building a big ol' statue in the jungle. The slaves rebelled and took over the site.|[[Crysta Markon]]|<ref name="TOR:AMT">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|A Musty Trail|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
The '''unfinished colossus''' was a unfinished monument located on the [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The statue was originally supposed to be made in honor of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Vowrawn]], and Vowrawn's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Qet]] brought several hundred [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] from offworld to the planet in order to build it. However, the slaves began the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion]]<ref name="TOR:SF" /> that would trouble the world for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] and the statue was never completed.
